fields.name: Limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of groups to be returned. Limit can range between 0 and 1000, and the default is 100.

fields.name: After
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is a group ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with group_abc, your subsequent call can include `after=group_abc` in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: Order
fields.description: Specifies the sort order of the returned groups.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the group was created.

fields.name: IsScimManaged
fields.description: Whether the group is managed through SCIM and controlled by your identity provider.
